use_case: Water-quality anomaly detection: the remote access portal's anomaly alert feature flags unusual chlorine residual, flow, tank level, and pump run-time patterns
vendor_or_model: Remote access portal vendor (machine-learning anomaly model; free trial; click-through terms allow model training on customer data)
data_categories: Process data only (residual, flows, levels, pump run times); no personal information
human_in_the_loop: Alerts are advisory only. The owner checks every alert at the panel or with the field test kit; the daily grab sample and dialer alarms stay the controls of record; the feature has no write access to setpoints
applicable_laws: 40 CFR 141.403(b)(3)(i)(B) (compliance monitoring stays the daily grab sample); 40 CFR 141.404(c) and 141.405(a)(1) (clocks start from the operator's determination, not from an alert); C-WATER-R01 300i-2(a)(1)(A)(iii) monitoring practices (voluntary benchmark)
status: In production (trial since 2026-06-01; approved 2026-08-31 for advisory use only, with conditions)

use_case: Consumer AI chat assistant used to draft customer letters (a 2025 rate-change letter and a boil water notice reminder)
vendor_or_model: Free consumer AI chat assistant (general-purpose language model)
data_categories: Letter text only; no customer list or credentials were entered
human_in_the_loop: Owner rewrites and approves every letter; public notices come only from the primacy agency's templates
applicable_laws: 40 CFR 141.205(a) (required notice content); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2) (no customer personal information in the tool)
